title: As shock of Raiders-Ravens botched Maxx Crosby trade wears off, is there a chance everyone ends up just fine?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As shock of Raiders-Ravens botched Maxx Crosby trade wears off, is there a chance everyone ends up just fine?
sources.description: Teams will still deal with the Ravens, even if they'll be wary of physicals that could blow up any deal. Crosby returns to a team that is actually better than when he left. And the NFL gets to revel in all of the attention.
